notes: The app icon and the floating pen now use the same gold pen mark as the website icon.
Only one pen appears now: the floating pen. The in-page pen is fully hidden inside the app.
Cleaned up Settings: removed the sync-server fields, the duplicate update checks, and the web version line. There is now a single Check for update button with your current app version shown below it.
Added a Sign in button on the home screen when you are logged out, and your profile picture when you are signed in.
A small hint now shows there are more categories to swipe through (All, Observe, Images, Connections, and more).
Reading sessions work properly: an active session shows a Reading banner, and sessions now have End, Resume, and Delete controls.
